title: AGENTS.md
text: Registry generation. Google Sheet “Site Cidados” / “Catálogo de dados” source truth dataset metadata. data-raw/build_registry.R reads googlesheets4, joins alias project tables data-raw/, queries Dataverse API deposit’s file list, writes JSON files. sheet carries alias column, supplies primary alias catalog row, overriding aliases.csv; aliases.csv still provides sub-aliases, one deposit can hold several datasets single sheet column say . is_spatial formats derived deposited file extensions, never sheet’s is_geoportal column, means something else. Auth uses CIDADOS_GS4_EMAIL .Renviron. alias DOI plus optional file pattern. Several aliases can share one deposit. pemob_anual pemob_harmonizada point 10.60873/FK2/5XUNNW separate file_pattern. get_dataset() applies pattern user selector. Entries carry status. active downloadable. unpublished catalogued study DOI yet ("doi": null): discoverable via list_datasets(include = "catalogued") downloaded. retired tombstone alias whose deposit withdrawn merged, carrying superseded_by reason error names replacement. list_datasets() shows active default. access separate status. tells user data can reached: download (DOI present), secure_room (held Insper’s secure data room), unpublished (catalogued, yet released). derived sheet’s access column DOI presence, never is_geoportal. Example registry entry: Server always dataverse.datascience.insper.edu.br — never ask user configure . Identifier resolution (order): Alias (e.g. "iptu_sp") -> look DOI inst/datasets.json DOI (e.g. "10.60873/FK2/7IXFPX") -> use directly Full URL (https://doi.org/..., Dataverse ?persistentId=doi:... landing page, bare doi: prefix) -> extract DOI 10.60873 prefix served. DOIs abort explicit message rather passed .

title: Download a dataset from Insper Dataverse — get_dataset
text: dataset dataset identifier. One : short alias, e.g. "iptu_sp" (see list_datasets() aliases). bare DOI, e.g. "10.60873/FK2/TOXCRF". full DOI URL, e.g. "https://doi.org/10.60873/FK2/TOXCRF". year integer character year used filter files dataset contains multiple annual files (e.g. year = 2023). filename exact filename download dataset. Overrides year file_pattern. file_pattern regex pattern matched filenames. Applied year filtering. docs Logical. TRUE, returns named list two elements: data (downloaded tibble/sf object) docs. dataset contains file whose name starts "documentacao" (e.g. "documentacao_iptu.xlsx"), file downloaded returned tibble. Otherwise docs named list metadata fetched Dataverse (title, description, authors, DOI, URL, year). Default FALSE.

title: Download a dataset from Insper Dataverse — get_dataset
text: docs = FALSE (default): tibble sf object "doi" attribute set. docs = TRUE: named list elements data docs.

title: Download a dataset from Insper Dataverse — get_dataset
text: deposit contains multiple files, function picks one format. Spatial datasets resolve GeoPackage result sf object; datasets favour RDS, Parquet, delimited text, Excel. Formats needing suggested package skipped installed. Use year, filename, file_pattern override choice. aliases share single Dataverse deposit. "pemob_anual" "pemob_harmonizada" point PEMOB deposit separated file pattern stored registry.

title: Download a dataset from Insper Dataverse — get_dataset
code: if (FALSE) { # live_examples() # By alias embarques <- get_dataset("embarques_mensais")  # By DOI, or by the DOI URL embarques <- get_dataset("10.60873/FK2/BPYHFB") embarques <- get_dataset("https://doi.org/10.60873/FK2/BPYHFB")  # Pick one year from a multi-year dataset pemob_2023 <- get_dataset("pemob_anual", year = 2023)  # Request a file by exact name, or by regex linhas <- get_dataset("estacoes_motiva", filename = "dim_line.rds") estacoes <- get_dataset("estacoes_motiva", file_pattern = "^dim_station")  # Return the data with its documentation result <- get_dataset("embarques_mensais", docs = TRUE) result$docs } if (FALSE) { # live_examples() && requireNamespace("sf", quietly = TRUE) # Spatial datasets return an sf object faixa_azul <- get_dataset("faixa_azul_sp") }
